post.summary: Screen and compare waste treatment pathways
post.description: Runs a coarse feasibility screening pass followed by a Monte Carlo uncertainty analysis for each requested pathway. Returns one PathwayResult per pathway. Rejected pathways have feasible=False with populated reasons. Does NOT perform LP allocation — use POST /decision/optimize for strict physical allocation.

post.description:
Run the LP allocation optimizer, then apply the Pareto filter.

Raises HTTP 422 if:
- The LP is infeasible (no valid allocation exists).
- Weight triplets in pareto_weight_sweep do not each sum to 1.0.
- Any key in compatibility_matrix or objective_coefficients is malformed.

Compute CRF-based annualised cost coefficients for a list of technologies.

Raises HTTP 422 if any technology parameter violates physical constraints
(e.g. capex < 0, throughput ≤ 0).

Compute itemized GHG delta for a proposed vs. baseline waste scenario.

Raises HTTP 422 if:
- IPCC boundary-matching rules are violated (BoundaryMismatchError).
- An unknown baseline_type or emission factor key is supplied.
- Any physical constraint on input values is violated.

Match a facility's product output to eligible buyers.

Raises HTTP 422 if:
- facility.available_volume ≤ 0.
- Any buyer bid_price < 0.
Identical requests return the same stored run (same id and audit_hash).

422.description: Request validation failed (detail is a list), or the inputs cannot be simulated (detail is a string): missing waste mass, invalid or non-finite parameters, unsupported process, or use_ml_yield=true (ML yield not yet supported).

compatibility_matrix.title: Compatibility Matrix
compatibility_matrix.description: JSON-safe flat dict: key = 'stream_id|tech_id' (e.g. 'stream_1|tech_A'), value = 1 (compatible) or 0 (incompatible).

objective_coefficients.title: Objective Coefficients
objective_coefficients.description: Flat dict: key = 'stream_id|tech_id', value = pre-computed per-tonne LP objective coefficient.

pareto_weight_sweep.title: Pareto Weight Sweep
pareto_weight_sweep.description: Optional list of weight dicts for a Pareto sweep. Each dict must contain w_cost, w_carbon, w_transport summing to 1.0.

OptimizeRequest.title: OptimizeRequest
OptimizeRequest.description:
Request body for POST /optimize.

supply and capacity are flat dicts keyed by string IDs.
Composite keys use the pipe '|' delimiter: 'stream_id|tech_id'.

farm_id.title: Farm Id
farm_id.description: Unique identifier of the source farm / waste stream.

waste_tpd.title: Waste Tpd
waste_tpd.description: Available waste feedstock in tonnes per day.

pathways.title: Pathways
pathways.description: Ordered list of pathway IDs to evaluate.

capex_inr.title: Capex Inr
capex_inr.description: Total capital expenditure in INR per pathway.

opex_inr_yr.title: Opex Inr Yr
opex_inr_yr.description: Annual operating expenditure in INR per pathway.

asset_life_yr.title: Asset Life Yr
asset_life_yr.description: Asset life in years per pathway (default: 20).

discount_rate.title: Discount Rate
discount_rate.description: Shared discount rate for CAPEX annualisation (default 7 %).

electricity_price_inr_kwh.title: Electricity Price Inr Kwh
electricity_price_inr_kwh.description: INR per kWh for electricity export (revenue) or import (cost).

gate_fee_inr_t.title: Gate Fee Inr T
gate_fee_inr_t.description: Tipping / gate fee received per tonne of waste (INR/tonne).

net_kwh_per_tonne.title: Net Kwh Per Tonne
net_kwh_per_tonne.description: Net kWh exported per tonne of waste processed (per pathway).

direct_ghg_kg_per_tonne.title: Direct Ghg Kg Per Tonne
direct_ghg_kg_per_tonne.description: Direct GHG emissions in kgCO2e per tonne processed.

capacity_tpd.title: Capacity Tpd
capacity_tpd.description: Maximum treatment capacity in tonnes/day per pathway.

distance_km.title: Distance Km
distance_km.description: One-way road distance from the waste source to the facility (km).

max_distance_km.title: Max Distance Km
max_distance_km.description: Hard upper-limit: pathways whose nearest facility exceeds this distance are rejected as infeasible (default 200 km).

mc_runs.title: Mc Runs
mc_runs.description: Number of Monte Carlo iterations for uncertainty quantification.

mc_cost_cv.title: Mc Cost Cv
mc_cost_cv.description: Coefficient of variation applied to annualised cost in MC runs.

mc_yield_cv.title: Mc Yield Cv
mc_yield_cv.description: Coefficient of variation applied to electricity yield in MC runs.

region.title: Region
region.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 region code for regional grid emission factors.

location_id.title: Location Id
location_id.description: Site identifier used to look up feedstock and location context from the P3 data service layer.

crop_type.title: Crop Type
crop_type.description: Crop type for ML-based yield prediction via YieldPredictor. When provided together with area_ha, overrides waste_tpd with the predicted daily biomass.

area_ha.title: Area Ha
area_ha.description: Cultivated area in hectares. Required when crop_type is set.

soil_index.title: Soil Index
soil_index.description: Soil quality index in [0, 1]. Used by YieldPredictor when crop_type and area_ha are provided (default 0.75 if omitted).

PathwayCompareRequest.title: PathwayCompareRequest
PathwayCompareRequest.description:
Request body for POST /pathways/compare.

All monetary values are in INR (Indian Rupees) to align with the India
pilot farm context. Energy in kWh. Mass in tonnes.

feasible.title: Feasible
feasible.description: True iff the pathway passed all coarse checks.

cost_inr_y.title: Cost Inr Y
cost_inr_y.description: Estimated annual cost in INR (annualised CAPEX + OPEX).

e_net_kwh_d.title: E Net Kwh D
e_net_kwh_d.description: Net kWh/day exported (negative = net electricity consumer).

model_status.title: Model Status
model_status.description: Optional status tag from the ML model or simulation engine, e.g. 'converged', 'fallback', 'extrapolated'.

warnings.title: Warnings
warnings.description: Non-fatal caveats, e.g. parameter assumptions or data gaps.

PathwayResult.title: PathwayResult
PathwayResult.description:
Screening result for a single evaluated pathway.

Frontend contract — field names and types are fixed.

UncertaintyRequest.title: UncertaintyRequest
UncertaintyRequest.description:
Parameters for a Monte Carlo uncertainty run.

Attributes
----------
n:
    Number of Monte Carlo iterations [dimensionless]. Must be 10–20 000.
seed:
    Random seed for reproducibility.
distribution_overrides:
    Optional dict mapping Params field names to distribution-spec dicts.
    Each spec must have at least ``"kind"`` and ``"args"`` keys (matching
    the ``Dist`` dataclass in montecarlo.py). When None the engine uses
    ``montecarlo.default_dists()``.

UncertaintyResult.title: UncertaintyResult
UncertaintyResult.description: Mirrors the dict returned by montecarlo.run_mc().
